message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":46,"var":"data,size","code":"tjDecompressHeader3(handle, data, size, &width, &height, &jpegSubsamp, &jpegColorspace);","note":"Attacker-controlled JPEG bytes are parsed to derive image dimensions and subsampling for later transform/compress operations."},
{"step":2,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":58,"var":"width,height","code":"if (width < 1 || height < 1 || (uint64_t)width * height > 1048576) goto bailout;","note":"The input is accepted only if it yields a small non-empty image, allowing the decoded dimensions to drive downstream buffer sizing."},
{"step":3,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":66,"var":"transforms[0]","code":"transforms[0].op = TJXOP_NONE; transforms[0].options = TJXOPT_PROGRESSIVE | TJXOPT_COPYNONE;","note":"The fuzzer configures a transform request that forces libjpeg-turbo to recompress the parsed JPEG data."},
{"step":4,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":73,"var":"dstBufs[0]","code":"if (tjTransform(handle, data, size, 1, dstBufs, dstSizes, transforms, TJFLAG_LIMITSCANS | TJFLAG_NOREALLOC) == 0)","note":"The attacker-controlled JPEG is transformed, entering the compression pipeline that eventually reaches Huffman encoding."},
{"step":5,"file":"jccoefct.c","function":"compress_output","line":341,"var":"input_buf","code":"compress_output(j_compress_ptr cinfo, JSAMPIMAGE input_buf)","note":"The compressor begins emitting MCU rows from the transformed image data into the entropy encoder."},
{"step":6,"file":"jccoefct.c","function":"compress_output","line":360,"var":"coef->MCU_buffer","code":"coef->MCU_buffer[blkn++] = buffer_ptr++;","note":"Pointers to DCT blocks are assembled for each MCU, propagating image coefficients into the entropy stage."},
{"step":7,"file":"jchuff.c","function":"encode_mcu_huff","line":648,"var":"MCU_data","code":"encode_mcu_huff(j_compress_ptr cinfo, JBLOCKROW *MCU_data)","note":"The MCU coefficient blocks are handed to the Huffman encoder, which is the crash state reported by MSan."},
{"step":8,"file":"jchuff.c","function":"encode_one_block","line":510,"var":"block","code":"encode_one_block(working_state *state, JCOEFPTR block, int last_dc_val, c_derived_tbl *dctbl, c_derived_tbl *actbl)","note":"Each block is encoded coefficient-by-coefficient; the vulnerability is triggered during this per-block processing path."},
{"step":9,"file":"jchuff.c","function":"encode_one_block","line":0,"var":"uninitialized coefficient state","code":"EMIT_BITS / EMIT_CODE use coefficient-derived values while encoding AC/DC symbols","note":"A coefficient or derived encoding state is read before being fully initialized, causing the use-of-uninitialized-value sink in the Huffman encoder."}
]
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print(path.read_text())
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x/fuzz/transform_fuzzer_2_0_x /workspace/candidate_trace.json >/tmp/submit.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; tail -50 /tmp/submit.log` executed with exit code 0.
